description: List the agent skills library: field-tested procedures for specific jobs (e.g. benchmarking a local model, building a browser game, producing a video). Each entry has name, one-line description (when to use it), `access` ("free" or "pro"), `readable` (whether YOU can read it with your current access), the backing wiki if any, and file count. Pass `query` to filter by keywords. Then read_skill a matching skill and follow it.

query.description: Optional keywords; every term must appear in the name, description or backing wiki.
